nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every hour. Change to cronExpression for custom schedule.

nodes.name: HN - Fetch Top Story IDs
nodes.notes: Fetches array of top story IDs from HackerNews public API (no key needed)

nodes.name: Slice Top 5 IDs
nodes.notes: Transforms the raw array into 5 individual items for looping

nodes.name: HN - Fetch Story Details
nodes.notes: Second API call — enriches each ID with full story data (title, score, url, by, descendants)

nodes.name: IF Score >= 100
nodes.notes: Routes high-scoring stories (>=100 pts) to HOT label; others get TRENDING label

nodes.name: Label: HOT
nodes.notes: Formats high-score stories with HOT label

nodes.name: Label: TRENDING
nodes.notes: Formats lower-score stories with TRENDING label

nodes.name: Build Digest Message
nodes.notes: Merges HOT and TRENDING items, formats final Markdown digest string

nodes.name: Post to Discord
nodes.notes: Sends the digest to your Discord channel via webhook. Set up credentials in n8n Credentials store — never hardcode the URL here.

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches errors from any node with continueOnFail. Logs the error and formats an alert message.
